_descriptor_type: A type of descriptor. One of 'simulation', 'trace', and 'perf'.
_architecture: A name of the available architectures (PARAMS.<architecture>) found in scarab repository, which defines the machine parameters of the default configuration.
_experiment: The name of the experiment. scarab-infra will create a new folder named containing all files needed to execute the simulation in the <ROOT_DIR>/simulations/<experiment> directory. The folder will also contain all generated simulation statistics/outputs.
_workload_manager: manual: run each exp scenario with all the simpoints at a time, slurm: Slurm schedules simulations based on its policy
_root_dir: Root directory mounted into the docker container home, for instance, the user's home directory
_application_dir: The path to the benchmark application directory used for tracing or simulation.
_scarab_path: The path to the scarab repository that contains the scarab binary used to run the experiment. Must be built from the td-load-rrip-min-extrapolate branch (adds td_load_rrip_min_rrpv / td_load_rrip_extrapolate / td_load_rrip_extrap_anchor, the signed-RRPV marked-RRIP hit handler, and the on-demand membound-fraction insert path).
_traces_dir: The local directory containing all simpointed traces
_top_simpoint: Run only top 3 simpoints stored in 'workloads_top_simp.json'.
_simulations: Marked-RRIP min-RRPV sweep. Self-contained / single-pass: the L1D computes each demanding load's memory-bound fraction ON DEMAND at fill (td_mem_cycles/td_window_cycles) -- no record run, no CSV, so --td_load_dir / --td_load_replay_key are not used. All configs extrapolate the fraction to an initial RRPV with the ramp anchored at 0.5, sweeping only the minimum (most-protected) RRPV. NOTE: SRRIP victim selection depends only on the RELATIVE order of RRPVs, and making the minimum more negative is an order-preserving rescaling, so these configs are expected to behave nearly identically -- this experiment is a control; the anchor is the knob that actually changes which lines are protected (see td_rrip_anchor_sweep_spec06). Compare IPC vs. baseline with plot_stat_change.py / plot_td_load_ipc.py.
_configurations: baseline = untouched machine (default DCACHE_REPL). Every rrip_* config extrapolates the on-demand membound fraction to an initial RRPV in [min, RRIP_DISTANT_VAL-1] with the ramp anchored at fraction 0.5 (fraction < 0.5 -> basic, 0.5 -> basic .. 1.0 -> min); they differ only in the minimum RRPV.

rrip_anchor50_extrap_d8._params: Extrapolate to min -64, ramp anchored at fraction 0.50 (only loads >= 0.5 protected).

rrip_anchor30_extrap_d8._params: Extrapolate to min -64, ramp anchored at fraction 0.30.

rrip_anchor10_extrap_d8._params: Extrapolate to min -64, ramp anchored at fraction 0.10.

rrip_anchor01_extrap_d8._params: Extrapolate to min -64, ramp anchored at fraction 0.01 (protect nearly every load with any membound cycles).

_collect_stats: Stats collection settings for ./sci --collect-stats. configs: optional list of configuration names to collect (null or omitted = all configurations).
_visualize: Visualization settings for ./sci --visualize. Configure baseline and counters.
_mem: Memory scheduling and collection settings for Slurm jobs.
